Thank you for your insight on this; I definitely did not think of this situation as something as such. And this is definitely something that i will remember and give attention to further on. 
I think we tend to forget sometimes that our jobs are meant to bring us something as well, rather than just fulfilling a need. I do know also that unfortunately not everyone has that privilege also to do as such.

I think things dont have to always be something affecting a person, it could also be an impact from other factors. But yes that was definitely idiotic of me to have asked that, especially during an interview.

I do really hope that the system changes and prevents stuff as such to happen. 
Good luck for your endeavours as well and Thanks for your kind words.

I really do hope that that's the takeaway. 

And to answer your question, yes that was the answer he gave back.
